segments.title: Explain the actual AI and tracking work
segments.narration: Muse Voice converts the glasses’ audio into Arabic text. Muse Spark helps pair Arabic phrases with portions of a published English translation. It can also assist with uncertain passage matches. Our software tracks the position, validates the source boundaries, and sends the current portion to the glasses.
